paths.description: Homepage and discovery feed, representing the primary browse journey.
Categories index, representing a dense taxonomy/listing template.
Best weekly listing, representing repeated media-card grids.
Representative video detail/player page, the core consumption surface.
Sign-up entry, representing the primary account form/flow.

findings.summary: Mobile pages render a 1024px desktop canvas
findings.evidence: Every tested 360px path reported scrollWidth 1024 and 664px horizontal overflow; screenshots show most content clipped off-screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, remove fixed desktop widths, and implement fluid intrinsic layouts that fit the visual viewport.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference leaves continuous shimmer animations running
findings.evidence: The prefers-reduced-motion: reduce probe found eight running shimmer animations, each with a 2000ms duration.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential shimmer/auto-motion inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and use a static loading treatment.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: The modern-CSS probe found no authored view-transition rules while the site exposes many route and modal state changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document and cross-document View Transitions for navigations and modal/state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long listings lack scroll-state-aware navigation feedback
findings.evidence: The homepage and categories screenshots show long feeds with static chrome; CSS inspection found no scroll-state container rules, progress marker, or equivalent position feedback.
findings.suggestedFix: Add lightweight scroll-state-aware chrome or progress/return affordances for long listings.

findings.summary: Promotional and age-verification chrome dominates the first viewport
findings.evidence: The 360px homepage screenshot shows an age-verification banner plus a sale banner above content, while a persistent 200px sidebar leaves only about 142px for the feed.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate mandatory notices, remove unrelated promotional interruption, and keep content primary with dismissible, non-obscuring UI.

findings.summary: Interactive overlays do not use semantic top-layer primitives
findings.evidence: DOM probes found zero dialog, popover, or details elements despite login, language, consent, and navigation overlays; these are custom controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog for modal flows, popover for transient menus, and details for disclosure with declarative light-dismiss.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch targets are not reliably perceivable
findings.evidence: Focused search controls computed outline:none; Lighthouse found two undersized/closely spaced targets and failed the target-size audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide strong :focus-visible styles and size/space pointer targets to at least the accessibility target guidance.

findings.summary: The sign-up flow is effectively off-screen on a 360px viewport
findings.evidence: The signup screenshot shows its card starting around x=327 on a 360px viewport, leaving only a sliver visible; the rendered DOM exposed only the header search form to the probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the registration card fit and reflow on mobile, retain its semantic form fields, and test completion at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Lab LCP misses the good Core Web Vitals threshold
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP at 3.1s (score 0.75), above the 2.5s good threshold; the trace measured 1.71s in a less-throttled run.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP element and remove critical-path delays, then verify under mobile throttling and field data.

findings.summary: Critical delivery includes avoidable blocking and weak caching
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 1140ms render-blocking savings and 111KiB cache-lifetime savings; HAR recorded 144 requests and 1.80MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, defer non-critical styles/scripts, set durable immutable caching for versioned assets, and prioritise the LCP resource.

findings.summary: The homepage ships avoidable unused and legacy code
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 57KiB unused CSS, 26KiB unused JavaScript, and 11KiB legacy JavaScript; HAR shows 61 scripts totaling about 998KiB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by route/component, remove unused CSS, and avoid legacy transforms for modern browsers.

findings.summary: Accessible names are missing or conflict with visible labels
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 2 unnamed buttons, 2 unnamed links, and 9 visible-label/accessibility-name mismatches.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each control a stable accessible name matching its visible label and remove empty interactive links.

findings.summary: Multiple text and control combinations fail minimum contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 13 color-contrast failures and one link-in-text-block failure; no prefers-contrast/forced-colors adaptation was found in the CSS probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise foreground/background contrast, avoid color-only link distinction, and add forced-colors/high-contrast support.

findings.summary: Focus and semantic structure contain material defects
findings.evidence: The focus probe found outline:none on search controls, while Lighthouse found malformed list semantics and the accessibility-tree audit failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Repair list/landmark semantics, ensure logical heading order, and make every keyboard focus state visible.

findings.summary: Viewport policy and layout prevent usable zoom/reflow
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport because scaling is constrained, and all five 360px archetypes rendered a 1024px layout viewport with 664px overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user scaling, use width=device-width, and verify WCAG reflow at 320 CSS px and 200% zoom.

findings.summary: Images lack stable dimensions and some are substantially oversized
findings.evidence: The image audit found 29 of 36 images without width/height, 12 rendered at less than half their natural width, and Lighthouse also failed unsized-images.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio and serve responsive candidates sized for each card.

findings.summary: Content-rich pages omit structured and social metadata
findings.evidence: The homepage probe found no JSON-LD and no Open Graph metadata despite representing a media catalog; localized alternate links were also absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org organization/video metadata and Open Graph/Twitter preview metadata that matches visible content.

findings.summary: Browser security policy and cookie protections are incomplete
findings.evidence: CSP contains only frame-ancestors, nosniff and Referrer-Policy are absent, and 3 of 5 cookies were not Secure while several use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an enforcing resource CSP, nosniff, strict Referrer-Policy, least-privilege Permissions-Policy, and Secure/SameSite cookie attributes.

findings.summary: The default page load has a broad third-party and analytics footprint
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 115 third-party requests and 1.61MB third-party transfer across 11 origins, including Google identity and ad/recommendation endpoints.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay non-essential third parties until intent/consent, minimise identifiers and payloads, and batch necessary analytics.

findings.summary: Localized variants are not backed by robust bidi/layout signals
findings.evidence: The page links many language subdomains but has no dir or hreflang; stylesheet inspection found 608 physical left/right rules versus 22 logical-property rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish hreflang alternates, set direction per locale, and migrate layout rules to logical properties with RTL tests.

findings.summary: Media delivery wastes bytes through oversized and legacy assets
findings.evidence: The image audit found 12 oversized images, 16 legacy-format images, 8 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, and 3 without responsive sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve modern responsive image candidates close to display size and lazily load non-critical media.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and continuous work are disproportionate
findings.evidence: About 89% of 1.80MB transferred was third-party, 61 scripts loaded, and eight shimmer animations remained active under reduced motion.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party/media budget, defer non-essential integrations, and stop background animation/work when unnecessary.

findings.summary: The initial page has a heavy memory/DOM footprint
findings.evidence: The baseline heap summary reported 663,016 heap nodes, 3,113,660 edges, and 35.3MB self size for a listing page with about 1,805 DOM elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce eager component/script allocation, virtualise long media lists, and profile dominant native/object/closure populations.
